mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_report ( vup_id, day, summary, selected_title, report_tone, platform_trend_id, fan_delta, coin_delta, popularity_delta, watch_heat_delta, reputation_delta, meme_delta, commercial_delta, highlight_event_id, debt_summary, risk_hint, visible_items_json, evidence_refs_json, template_refs_json, render_version, strategy_panel_json ) VALUES ( #{vupId}, #{day}, #{summary}, #{selectedTitle}, #{reportTone}, #{platformTrendId}, #{fanDelta}, #{coinDelta}, #{popularityDelta}, #{watchHeatDelta}, #{reputationDelta}, #{memeDelta}, #{commercialDelta}, #{highlightEventId}, #{debtSummary}, #{riskHint}, #{visibleItemsJson}, #{evidenceRefsJson}, #{templateRefsJson}, #{renderVersion}, #{strategyPanelJson} )
